chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from one of his companions, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever goes out from his house wearing a turban beneath his chin, intending a journey, will not be affected during his journey by theft, nor by burning, nor by misfortune.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of wearing a turban beneath the chin when traveling?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* under the chapter on turbans, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the physical act of wearing a turban beneath the chin to divine protection during travel. It reflects the Shia tradition of viewing specific Sunnah practices as *tawassul* (means of grace) for safeguarding against worldly misfortunes like theft, fire, and general calamities.
